paragraph: In 2025, [information and communication employed 0.44 per cent of all workers in Angola](<https://ilostat.ilo.org/data/>), by the International Labour Organization's labour force series, ILOSTAT. The same series gives 0.31 per cent in 2021 and 0.44 per cent in 2024, so the share rose by 0.12 points since 2021. The figure counts all employment in publishing, broadcasting, telecommunications and information technology services, not graduates alone. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No figure of 0.6 per cent or more has been found. Establishing would need information and communication to employ 0.6 per cent or more of all workers.
